chars.YOUSSEF: a young Moroccan man about 25, short black hair, light trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow overshirt over a white t-shirt, dark blue jeans, white sneakers, a black backpack
chars.BOSS: a Moroccan woman about 40, elegant, black hair in a sleek bun, red lipstick, gold hoop earrings, wearing a burgundy blazer over a cream blouse and black trousers
chars.STAFF: three Moroccan office workers in plain grey and light-blue shirts sitting at desks

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF walks fast on a sunny Casablanca street in the morning holding a coffee cup, excited smile, first day of a new job, white modern office buildings behind him. 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm colors, vertical.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF daydreaming on a city tram, eyes half closed, big proud grin; a dreamy thought bubble above him shows him in a big private office with a leather chair and a secretary bringing him papers. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF stands at the glass entrance of a modern company building, looking up confidently and fixing his overshirt collar, reception desk visible inside. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, no text or logos.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF climbs a bright office staircase toward a closed wooden office door at the top, slightly nervous face, adjusting his backpack strap. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF stands frozen at the open office door, surprised wide eyes; BOSS sits behind a big desk, leaning back in her chair with a confident, slightly amused smile, looking straight at him. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of YOUSSEF standing in the office, awkward uneasy face, one eyebrow raised, rubbing the back of his neck, a sweat drop on his temple, comic expression. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: BOSS stands and shakes hands warmly with YOUSSEF across her desk, gesturing with her other hand as she explains, YOUSSEF nodding politely, bright office with plants. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF walks through an open-plan office glancing sideways; STAFF at their desks all have grumpy frowning faces, arms crossed. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, no text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: STAFF lean over their computer screens glaring hard at YOUSSEF with narrowed suspicious eyes; YOUSSEF in the foreground holding his backpack strap, gulping nervously, comic tension. 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical, no text.
